webview.proxy.install.title: Install MITM proxy CA
webview.proxy.install.intro: Trust the generated certificate so Cursor can use HTTPS through the proxy. On macOS and Windows you can install automatically (you will see a native permission prompt). On Linux, download the certificate and run the terminal commands below.
webview.proxy.install.mac.autoInstall.bo: Adds the CA to the system keychain. macOS will ask for your password to allow changes — you can accept or cancel.
webview.proxy.install.win.autoInstall.bo: Adds the CA to Trusted Root Certification Authorities. Windows will show a UAC prompt — accept to continue or cancel to skip.
webview.proxy.uninstall.confirmBody: This will remove the MITM proxy CA from your system trust store. You can reinstall it later if needed.
webview.proxy.uninstall.linuxManual:
On Linux, run these commands:
sudo rm /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/cursor-accounts-mitm.crt
sudo update-ca-certificates
webview.proxy.install.manual.title: Manual installation (alternative)
webview.proxy.install.manual.intro: If automatic installation does not work, follow these steps:
webview.proxy.install.certNotReady: Start the proxy once to generate the CA certificate before installing.
webview.proxy.install.download.title: Download the CA certificate
webview.proxy.install.download.body: Save the certificate file, then complete the trust steps below using that file.
webview.proxy.install.mac.step1.title: Open Keychain Access
webview.proxy.install.mac.step1.body: Open the Keychain Access app on your Mac.
webview.proxy.install.mac.step2.title: Import the certificate
webview.proxy.install.mac.step2.body: Choose File → Import Items… and select the .pem file you saved in step 1.
webview.proxy.install.mac.step3.title: Open certificate settings
webview.proxy.install.mac.step3.body: Double-click the imported "Cursor Accounts MITM Proxy CA" certificate.
webview.proxy.install.mac.step4.title: Set trust to Always
webview.proxy.install.mac.step4.body: Expand Trust and set "When using this certificate" to Always Trust.
webview.proxy.install.mac.step5.title: Confirm changes
webview.proxy.install.mac.step5.body: Close the dialog and enter your password when prompted.
webview.proxy.install.mac.code.title: Alternatively, use Terminal
webview.proxy.install.win.step1.title: Open the certificate file
webview.proxy.install.win.step1.body: Double-click the .pem file you saved in step 1.
webview.proxy.install.win.step2.title: Run the certificate wizard
webview.proxy.install.win.step2.body: Choose Install Certificate → Local Machine → place in Trusted Root Certification Authorities.
webview.proxy.install.win.step3.title: Finish installation
webview.proxy.install.win.step3.body: Complete the wizard and confirm any administrator prompts.
webview.proxy.install.win.code.title: Alternatively, use PowerShell (Administrator)
webview.proxy.install.linux.step1.title: Copy certificate to system store
webview.proxy.install.linux.step1.body: Copy your saved .pem file into the system CA directory (replace the source path with where you saved the certificate):
webview.proxy.install.linux.step2.title: Update CA certificates
webview.proxy.install.linux.step2.body: Run update-ca-certificates so the system trusts the new CA.
webview.proxy.install.linux.step3.title: Chromium / Electron only (optional)
webview.proxy.install.linux.step3.body: If you only need Node/Electron trust without system-wide install: export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS={certPath}
